description: Referral link for a code (?ref=<code>, 30-day first-referrer attribution). This tool is read-only. Pass code for a known public referral code — no auth needed; the link is deterministic. Omit code and sign in (or send an API key) to get or create your own code — no payout address required to activate; earnings accrue until you set one. Referrers earn 30% of our margin (not the sale price); payouts are crypto-only USDC on Base. Programme terms: https://stabledomains.net/affiliates.json. Available on the full MCP and the read-only discover MCP (/api/mcp/discover).
